Create an ATL transformation module named `DSL2KM3` that transforms a `DomainModel` in the DSL metamodel into a KM3 `Metamodel`.

Define helpers:
- `needTurnOnClass()` on `Relationship` deciding when a relationship must be represented as a KM3 `Class` (incoming roles, super/sub types, properties).
- `getRoles(c : Class)` returning roles whose relationship does not become a class.
- `isEmbedding()` on `Role` to infer containment.

Then create rules:
- `Metamodel` building the root KM3 `Metamodel` and two `Package`s (main + `PrimitiveTypes`).
- `Class` mapping DSL `Class`.
- `Relation2Class` mapping qualifying `Relationship` to KM3 `Class`.
- `SimpleReference` and `ComplexReference` mapping `Role`s to KM3 `Reference`s (including opposites, multiplicities, containment).
- `Attribute` mapping `ValueProperty` to KM3 `Attribute`.
- `Enumeration`, `EnumLiteral`, `DataType` mapping corresponding DSL types to KM3.

-- End of request.

module DSL2KM3;
create OUT : KM3 from IN : DSL;

helper context DSL!Relationship def: needTurnOnClass() : Boolean =
	not self.superType.oclIsUndefined() or
	self.subTypes->notEmpty() or
	self.properties->notEmpty() or
	DSL!Role.allInstances()->exists(r | r.type = self);

helper def: getRoles(c : DSL!Class) : Sequence(DSL!Role) =
	DSL!Role.allInstances()->select(r | r.source = c and not r.relation.needTurnOnClass());

helper context DSL!Role def: isEmbedding() : Boolean =
	if self.relation.isEmbedding then
		self.relation.roles->first() = self
	else
		false
	endif;

rule Metamodel {
	from
		m : DSL!DomainModel
	to
		mm : KM3!Metamodel (
			contents <- Sequence{p, pt}
		),
		p : KM3!Package (
			name <- m.namespace,
			contents <- m.classifiers->union(m.types->select(t | t.oclIsTypeOf(DSL!Enumeration)))
		),
		pt : KM3!Package (
			name <- 'PrimitiveTypes',
			contents <- m.types->select(t | t.oclIsTypeOf(DSL!SimpleType))
		)
}

rule Class {
	from
		c : DSL!Class
	to
		out : KM3!Class (
			name <- c.name,
			isAbstract <- c.isAbstract,
			supertypes <- if c.superType.oclIsUndefined() then Sequence{} else Sequence{c.superType} endif,
			structuralFeatures <- c.properties->union(thisModule.getRoles(c))
		)
}

rule Relation2Class {
	from
		r : DSL!Relationship (
			r.needTurnOnClass()
		)
	to
		out : KM3!Class (
			name <- r.name,
			isAbstract <- r.isAbstract,
			supertypes <- if r.superType.oclIsUndefined() then Sequence{} else Sequence{r.superType} endif,
			structuralFeatures <- r.properties
		)
}

rule SimpleReference {
	from
		r : DSL!Role (
			not r.relation.needTurnOnClass()
		)
	to
		out : KM3!Reference (
			name <- r.name,
			lower <- r.min,
			upper <- if r.isUnbounded then -1 else r.max endif,
			isOrdered <- r.isOrdered,
			isUnique <- true,
			type <- r.type,
			isContainer <- r.isEmbedding(),
			opposite <- r.relation.roles->select(ro | ro <> r)->first(),
			owner <- r.source
		)
}

rule ComplexReference {
	from
		r : DSL!Role (
			r.relation.needTurnOnClass()
		)
	to
		out : KM3!Reference (
			name <- r.name,
			lower <- r.min,
			upper <- if r.isUnbounded then -1 else r.max endif,
			isOrdered <- r.isOrdered,
			isUnique <- true,
			type <- r.relation,
			isContainer <- r.isEmbedding(),
			owner <- r.source
		)
}

rule Attribute {
	from
		a : DSL!ValueProperty
	to
		out : KM3!Attribute (
			name <- a.name,
			lower <- 1,
			upper <- 1,
			isOrdered <- false,
			isUnique <- true,
			type <- a.type,
			owner <- a.owner
		)
}

rule Enumeration {
	from
		e : DSL!Enumeration
	to
		out : KM3!Enumeration (
			name <- e.name,
			literals <- e.literals
		)
}

rule EnumLiteral {
	from
		l : DSL!EnumerationLiteral
	to
		out : KM3!EnumLiteral (
			name <- l.name
		)
}

		out : KM3!DataType (
			name <- d.name
		)
}
